_comment: 🧩️ ZIP 2.0/✳️any's own contribution to the repository test platform — its mutation oracle registration and its declared mutation vocabulary (wave 7, ticket 26/08/23/END-TO-END-TESTING-REFACTOR). Discovered by convention alongside ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio's own top-level manifest; merged into one registry, no central edit required.

oracles.rationale: The reference ZIP reader/writer of the Rust ecosystem, driven here through the full add/remove/rename/set-data/set-comment/set-snapshot mutation vocabulary this subset declares, with the archive-level comment kept live (never ignored) so `set-archive-comment` is a real, checked mutation and not a no-op. Distinct id and capability from the top-level `zip` entry's `zip-archive` (plain create/read/remove-member evidence): reusing that entry outside its surveyed capability would fail the contract's oracle-capability-mismatch check, and a mutation vocabulary belongs to the subset that declares it, not to the format generally.

comparisonProfiles.description: ZIP archives compared as a SET of members by name, uncompressed size and content digest, PLUS the archive-level comment as a normative field. Entry order, compression method and level, timestamps, attributes and the extra field remain writer freedom. Differs from the base `semantic-archive-v1` profile only in that `comment` is NOT ignored: this subset's vocabulary declares `set-archive-comment` as one of its mutation kinds, so the comment has to actually participate in the comparison for that mutation to be a checked test rather than a no-op.
